LESSON: RELATIONSHIP 6.2.1 CARE AND DUA FOR THE SICK

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you do for 6.2.1 care and dua learner should be able to: the Sick. La ba’asa alaika tuhurun the sick?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recite the dua to comfort the inshallah. 2.
2. Identify ways of showing care Visit them for the sick to enhance the spirit pray for them of brotherhood assist them

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: RELATIONSHIP 6.2.1 CARE AND DUA FOR THE SICK
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3

Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

4. Make one local Kenya example of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?
